en.abdullah-al-shahin: (1) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from Ali bin al-Hasan at-Taymali from his brothers Muhammad and Ahmad from their father from Tha’laba bin Maymoon and Jamee’ al-Kinasi from Abu Baseer from Kamil that Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said:

“When al-Qa’im appears, he will invite the people to a new mission as the Prophet (sw) has invited the people to a new mission. Islam has begun strange and it will return strange as it has begun. Blessed are the strangers!”
